author: UmbreonMessiah
body:
Okay, So I've been noticing this alot lately. A game is full, and these unranked players want to join. So what do they do? Post something among the lines of "Hey! X is happening in X lobby! Come quick!" And then that poor gullible soul goes to see if it's true, and then gets their spot jacked. Now, If there is already a punishment for this, I'm sorry, but I haven't seen it. And, its quite a mean thing to do, and works often considering that MC has a fairly large amount of young people.

And NO, I AM NOT THAT GULLIBLE!
:c

           -Always ReSyncing
                       ^English^
